about_short_description.short_description: Haseel  is a fresh fruits and vegetables ecommerce platform .

product.name: Haseel Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app for ordering fresh fruits, vegetables, and meats directly from farms to customers' homes with flexible payment and delivery scheduling options.

product.name: Fresh Produce and Meat Supply
product.description: Provision of fresh fruits, vegetables, dates, nuts, and fresh meats sourced from farms and delivered to customers using refrigerated vehicles.

product.name: Subscription Service (Haseel Go)
product.description: An annual subscription offering free delivery of fresh produce and meats throughout the year for customers using Haseel's delivery service.

product.name: Basic Supply Boxes
product.description: Pre-packaged boxes containing essential fresh fruits and vegetables tailored to meet the needs of families.
